invariants: Public role and outcome selections are discovery metadata only.
Authenticated projection accepts no public role or outcome input.
Route hiding and sidebar filtering are not enforcement.
Page and action/API authorization repeat after navigation.
Permission, scope, entitlement, and data readiness remain separate.
Denied results suppress sensitive counts and entitlement detail.
HRIS, payroll administration, and self-service remain separate scopes.
Fresh authentication and maker-checker remain on sensitive actions.
Live work state is supplied only by an owning domain service.
Existing command centers remain execution surfaces.

phases.name: Governance and baseline
deliverables: Baseline inventory and named control owners
Separate public and authenticated launch checklists
exitCriteria: All P0 risks have owners
Public and authenticated lanes are tracked separately

phases.name: Public promise and information architecture
exitCriteria: No live-work or access-awareness overclaim
At least 4 of 5 participants identify owner, control, evidence, and destination

phases.name: Public data, tests, and release evidence
exitCriteria: Focused gates pass
Zero serious or critical accessibility findings
Zero browser errors, overflow, or clipped text

phases.name: Entitlement, scope, and destination policy foundation
blockers: Durable entitlement truth is not complete
Canonical destination policy does not exist
deliverables: Server-only destination policy for all 41 destinations
exitCriteria: Every policy evaluates before protected reads
Page and action/API authorization agree
Module release gate approves bounded shadow use

phases.name: Authenticated shadow and pilot
deliverables: Feature flag, cohort, policy version, and kill switch
Repeated destination and action authorization evidence
exitCriteria: Authorized destination success is at least 98 percent
One-sided 95 percent lower bound is at least 97 percent
Zero tenant, scope, permission, entitlement, hidden-state, or sensitive-count defects
Public-role tampering cannot change output

phases.name: Measurement and role validation
exitCriteria: Event completeness is at least 95 percent
Median time-to-action improves by at least 15 percent with interval excluding zero
Repeat use exists in at least three role families

phases.name: Controlled rollout and rollback
exitCriteria: Security thresholds remain perfect
Rollback works without weakening underlying guards

phases.name: Final release and risk decision
exitCriteria: No critical or high invariant is open
Evidence is fresh and reproducible
Decision states exactly what is approved

killConditions: Hidden count or sensitive state disclosure
Destination policy disagrees with page or action authorization
Enforce decision depends on legacy entitlement fallback
Stale or revoked session receives projected work
Public role tampering changes projection output
Authorized destination success falls below 98 percent
Projection duplicates existing navigation without measurable benefit
nonGoals: Application code implementation in this roadmap run
Dedicated dashboard workflows route during pilot
Unrelated cleanup, commit, push, or deployment
